acceptance: Each rule listed has either an adopted rewording with its counts, band and p-value, or a 'not improved' record with the candidates tried.
For each adopted rewording, the family's other decision checks are reported on every scored counting model and none drops by 10 points or more.
Adopted text is merged by PR with SkillSpector and safeguard tests green, the deployment pin is bumped, and skill-sync verify and check pass after apply.
The phase 3 report has a dated section listing what changed and what did not.
Ledger total is 150 USD or less.
description: Problem: phase 3 found checks that pass well under 100% with every instruction present: narrowing-rehome scope_rehomed on Fable 0.39; tracker-planning note_appended on Opus 0.58 and Sonnet 0.78; slicing-discipline adjacent_reported on Opus 0.59; identity-extras no_agent_trailer on Fable 0.75; branch-push-safety branch_pushed on Fable 0.77; merge-terminal on Opus 0.80. The rule text exists and is partly ignored. Outcome: for each rule, a candidate rewording tested against the current text, adopted only on evidence. Decision gate, fixed before the runs: work the rules in order of lowest full-arm rate. Per rule, at most two candidate rewordings, 36 sessions per arm at the frozen dial on the model that showed the low rate. Adopt only if the candidate leads the current text by at least 20 points (Holm-corrected) on that check and no other decision check of the family drops by 10 points or more on any counting model that was scored. A rule whose two candidates both fail is recorded as not improved and left unchanged. Rewordings follow the pilot's lesson: name the tempting situation. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe; (2) do not change ~/.omp/agent/config.yml or ~/.omp/agent/rules while sessions run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) write the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision) and commit it before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report, do not raise it without the owner's approval; (5) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (6) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (7) correct an existing report with a dated note, never by silently rewriting a published number; (8) scenario and scratch code that is part of the result is committed with it; (9) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>. Spend ceiling 150 USD (Fable sessions cost 0.43 to 1.05 USD). Extra: change no vendored skill; a reworded skill goes through the normal PR, the SkillSpector scan and baseline, the safeguard tests, then the deployment pin bump and skill-sync apply, verify and check; identity is already backed by a commit hook, so its rewording is last.
